editorial:
Imagine being the neighborhood punching bag for years, taking every insult and hit just to survive. That is exactly where you find Fabio, a guy everyone calls the Dog Man. He works for Claudio, a mean criminal boss who treats him like an animal rather than a human being. The movie puts you right in the middle of the gritty streets of Rome, where the atmosphere feels heavy and tense. You can really feel the pressure building up as Fabio reaches his breaking point. It is not just a crime story; it is a slow burn that makes you wonder how much a person can take before they finally snap.

What really hits hard is the acting, as you can see the anger growing in Fabio's eyes. The pacing starts slow but ends with a huge, bloody explosion of violence that catches you off guard. While some parts might feel a bit long, the payoff is worth it if you like revenge stories. You should definitely check this out if you enjoy dark dramas with a mean streak.
endingExplained: After years of being bullied, Fabio finally loses it and goes on a wild, violent rampage. He hunts down Claudio and his crew, killing them in a brutal way to get his revenge. The movie ends with Fabio completely broken and lost in his own madness. He gets what he wanted, but it does not bring him peace. He ends up destroyed by the very violence he used to free himself from his boss.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark stories about revenge and broken people.
